entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to process a return. Can I get the order number, or do you need it?
I can certainly help you with that. I will need the order number to pull up your details.
It's VF886-012. Look, I just want a yes or no. Can I return these or not?
One moment while I look that up for you... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes, delivered nine days ago. What seems to be the issue with them?
They don't fit. They gave me terrible blisters after one ride. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that. I know how frustrating that can be. Did you have any issues with installing the cleats or was it purely a fit issue?
The cleats are fine, the shoes are the problem. Can you process the refund or not? I don't have a lot of time.

Yes, absolutely. Since you received the item nine days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I have just initiated the return process for you. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we receive the cycling shoes, your refund will be processed.
Okay, that's what I needed to know. Thank you.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
